text.en: The rms speed of the molecules of a gas at temperature $T$ is $v$. If the temperature is made $4T$, the rms speed becomes:
text.hi: तापमान $T$ पर किसी गैस के अणुओं की वर्ग-माध्य-मूल चाल $v$ है। ताप $4T$ करने पर यह चाल हो जाएगी:

questions.solution: $v_{rms} = \sqrt{3RT/M}$, so $v_{rms} \propto \sqrt{T}$. Making $T$ four times doubles the speed: $2v$.

questions.text: For a particle in uniform circular motion, which statements are correct?
options: Its acceleration points towards the centre
questions.solution: Speed stays the same but the direction of velocity keeps changing, so there is a centripetal acceleration towards the centre.
